## 改动 / Changes

说明改了什么，以及为什么需要改。Describe what changed and why.

## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `docker compose config --quiet`
- [ ] 两个浏览器的连接流程已验证，若相关 / Tested the connection flow in two browsers, if relevant
- [ ] 手机端文件流程已验证，若相关 / Tested mobile file transfer, if relevant

## 边界 / Boundaries

- [ ] 没有提交密钥、真实 TURN 地址、凭据或抓包信息 / No keys, private TURN endpoints, credentials, or packet captures are included
- [ ] 中英文文案已同步 / Chinese and English copy is in sync
- [ ] 已说明本地存储、协议、隐私或部署配置的变化 / Local storage, protocol, privacy, and deployment changes are documented
